description: This file declares interfaces related to a GStreamer dispatcher thread, including factory and thread classes, within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. It defines the creation method for dispatcher threads and deletes copy/move constructors and assignment operators for the thread class.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThreadFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating GStreamer dispatcher thread instances.

classes.name: IGstDispatcherThread
classes.description: Interface representing a GStreamer dispatcher thread, with copy and move constructors and assignment operators deleted to prevent copying or moving instances.

methods.name: createGstDispatcherThread
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a new IGstDispatcherThread instance, given a client, pipeline, and IGstWrapper reference.
